method: Each section read in full by a machine-assisted reviewer against the packs and the ground catalogue as of this date; not a legal review.

sections.bearsOn: Establishes the Humbug landscape unit (Map 3) as the area the objectives apply to.
Sets the unit's old growth distribution, by variant, as the OGMAs on Map 3; a block meets it by leaving those OGMAs intact.
sections.gapNote: The ogma screen draws the OGMAs and the old forest module counts them toward PG TSA Objectives A and B; no rule tests that a block stays out of them.

sections.bearsOn: Requires the Map 3 OGMAs to be maintained, so a block or road inside one meets 3.02 and 3.03.
sections.gapNote: The rules ask the order’s questions once the reviewer names the order; the OGMA screen still leaves harvest and road reach unknown.

sections.bearsOn: Limits cutting in an OGMA to what is absolutely necessary for insect or disease control, keeping old-growth structure where a threat to adjacent stands requires intervention.
sections.gapNote: The rules ask the order’s questions once the reviewer names the order; the OGMA screen still leaves harvest and road reach unknown.

sections.bearsOn: Allows permanent and temporary roads in an OGMA only where there is no other practicable option, and requires temporary ones to be deactivated, rehabilitated and planted as soon as possible; unlike Dome and Slim it names permanent roads expressly.
sections.gapNote: The rules ask the order’s questions once the reviewer names the order; the OGMA screen still leaves harvest and road reach unknown.

sections.bearsOn: Allows fire suppression in OGMAs; it does not bear on making a block.
Required forest development plans submitted after the effective date to be consistent; under FRPA it binds through Land Act s. 93.8 and the FSP.
sections.gapNote: A document check that the FSP carries results or strategies for the OGMAs.
